scientific_integrity: A self-contained factorial-sandwich proof gives the exact logarithmic lower-tail exponents and the support concentration. A separate standalone program checks finite instances; its output does not certify infinite claims.
scientific_limitations: The complete finite cardinality formula for the same path monoid is prior work. The theorem gives no large-deviation prefactor or central-limit-scale fluctuations. Priority beyond the examined materials is unconfirmed.
title: Sharp lower-tail exponents for random partial automorphisms of a finite path
